title: StockSmart Program Agreement — Minimum Term, Notice, Early Exit and Special Stock Buyback Terms
content:
### Term and exit provisions of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program, by tier

| Tier | Minimum program term from go-live, months | Calendar days of written notice to end the program | Bin removal and early exit fee if the program ends before the minimum term, USD | Customer buys the special stock held for the program when it ends | Price at which special stock is bought back |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StockSmart Self-Scan | 0 | 30 | 0.00 | yes | last billed unit price |
| StockSmart Monthly Service | 12 | 30 | 500.00 | yes | last billed unit price |
| StockSmart Biweekly Service | 12 | 30 | 750.00 | yes | last billed unit price |
| StockSmart Weekly Service | 12 | 60 | 1000.00 | yes | last billed unit price |
| StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 24 | 60 | 2500.00 | yes | last billed unit price |
| StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 36 | 90 | 10000.00 | yes | last billed unit price |

**Provision 1.** StockSmart Self-Scan has no minimum term (0 months) and an early exit fee of 0.00.

**Provision 2.** On every tier the special (non-catalog) stock Corbett holds for the program is bought by the customer when the program ends, at the last billed unit price.

**Hypothetical reading.** A StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service program has a 24-month minimum term from its go-live; written notice to end it runs 60 calendar days; an ending before the 24 months are complete carries 2500.00.
